source_text: Obstetric complications are markedly increased, with 39.0% of type I and 65.9% of type II cases facing delivery issues like perineal tears (27.8–48.8%), prolonged labor (15.6–36.6%), and episiotomy needs (20.0–30.5%), yielding odds ratios of 4.82–9.06 relative to uncut women (11.7% complications); fresh stillbirths occur in 2.9–6.1% of affected deliveries versus 0%.
